title: Heavy Core Craft
description: Adds Heavy Core crafting to Minecraft, If you're too lazy to delve into Trial Chambers, this is for you.
body:
**Adds Heavy Core crafting to Minecraft
If you're too lazy to delve into Trial Chambers, this is for you.**

_I tried to make the crafting challenging but also fair. I think you won't be too lazy to go to the nether, unlike trial chambers._
